tracks.title: 搖鈴仔的阿伯 Iô Lîng-á ê A-peh
tracks.mood: cheeky, skipping and proud, a whole school dancing to one old man's wrist
tracks.subject: the electric school bell at a Taiwanese primary school breaks for a week and the old school caretaker rings the periods by hand with a rusty brass handbell from the storeroom, until the pupils refuse to go in when the repaired bell returns

tracks.title: 會行路的洗衫機 Ē Kiânn-lōo ê Sé-sann-ki
tracks.mood: sunny, brassy and giddy, a bargain that dances off across the kitchen
tracks.subject: an auntie who haggles across three towns' secondhand shops for one used washing machine, gets it home for 3,500 with a free hose, and on its first spin cycle it walks across the kitchen while her husband, son and daughter chase it, until the daughter sits on it and her husband wedges a wood chip under its short leg

tracks.title: 接枝 Tsiap-ki
tracks.mood: tender, sly and patient, a husband keeping a three-year secret in a tree
tracks.subject: a husband secretly grafting Irwin (aiwen) mango scions onto the sour native mango tree his grandfather planted behind the house, because his wife buys Irwin mangoes at the market every year, and three summers later the tree fruits both kinds

tracks.title: 國民法官六號 Kok-bîn Huat-kuann La̍k-hō
tracks.mood: deadpan, tense and quietly dutiful
tracks.subject: an ordinary man drawn by lot as citizen judge number six (Taiwan's citizen judge system) for a six-day fraud trial, who may tell no one, tells his wife it's a business trip, eats cold pork-chop lunchboxes in silence with five strangers, and casts his vote

tracks.title: 九降風的菜脯 Káu-kàng-hong ê Tshài-póo
tracks.mood: hazy, tender and windswept, a long dry winter on a rooftop
tracks.subject: a granddaughter spending one dry, windy Hsinchu winter on the rooftop with her living grandmother making sun-dried radish (菜脯): weeks of salting, turning the radish morning and night on bamboo trays in the northeast 'nine-descending' wind, while the grandmother talks about working the salt pans and the salty radish grandpa brought when he first came courting

tracks.title: 我毋是鮭魚 Guá M̄-sī Kue-hî
tracks.mood: deadpan, sheepish and bouncy, a joke the singer has finally stopped living inside
tracks.subject: a man who changed his legal name to 'Lim Salmon' in 2021 for a free sushi-restaurant feast and has lived with it on every bank queue screen and job interview since, back at the household registration office for his third and, by law, last name change, while the clerk reminds him this one is final

tracks.title: 四點落梨山 Sì Tiám Lo̍h Lî-san
tracks.mood: giddy, wide awake and racing the clock, a mountain descent against the auction bell
tracks.subject: a young woman who takes over her father's cabbage truck the night his back gives out, loads four hundred crates of high-mountain cabbage in Lishan at three in the morning and races down the switchbacks through Yilan at first light to make the seven o'clock auction at the Taipei fruit and vegetable wholesale market, her mother phoning every hour and one cabbage bouncing off the back on a bend

tracks.title: 菜寮溪 Tshài-liâu-khe
tracks.mood: sunny, stubborn and warm-hearted, an old man's small triumph
tracks.subject: a retired farmer in Zuojhen, Tainan, who walks the dry white riverbed of the Tsailiao Creek every winter with a small hammer looking for fossils, is called mad by the village until the young woman at the local fossil museum identifies his find as a rhinoceros tooth and writes his name under it, and now leads a line of children with toy hammers

tracks.title: 通譯 Thong-i̍k
tracks.mood: tense, dry and wry, with a soft landing
tracks.subject: a young Taigi interpreter at a district court civil hearing, translating for an old farmer who speaks only Taigi against a construction company whose new wall sits thirty centimetres inside his field, swallowing the curse he shouts at the company's lawyer, and hearing the judge order a fresh survey

tracks.title: 蜂仔佮龍眼花 Phang-á kah Lîng-gíng-hue
tracks.mood: tender, shy and warm, a sunny week of blossom season side by side
tracks.subject: a young migratory beekeeper who trucks forty hives into a Dongshan longan orchard for the April blossom and courts the owner's daughter while she walks the rows with him in the midday heat; she laughs at his veil, binds a sting on his wrist with her handkerchief, dips her finger into the first frame of longan honey before her father can, and asks him to bring the bees back next April

tracks.title: 掠蛇阿傑 Lia̍h-tsuâ A-kia̍t
tracks.mood: swaggering, deadpan and proud of a small-town legend
tracks.subject: the ballad of A-kiat, a 23-year-old rookie at a rural Pingtung fire station whose calls are never fires: a hornet nest at the school gate, a cat stuck up a betel palm, then a two-metre cobra coiled on the uncle's leather shoes in an auntie's shoe cabinet, which he takes with tongs and a cloth sack and lets go at the foot of Mount Dawu, until the whole township calls him the Snake King

tracks.title: 我佇下跤 Guá Tī Ē-kha
tracks.mood: tender, playful and quietly devoted
tracks.subject: a couple at a Kaohsiung indoor climbing gym on a Saturday afternoon, her first time on a rope: he ties her figure-eight knot and checks it three times, belays her up the red route, and when her foot slips halfway and she hangs in midair hugging the wall he talks her into sitting back on the rope; then they swap, he falls and his extra thirty kilos yank her off the floor so they both hang there laughing, and on her last try she slaps the top hold and turns to find him still watching her from below

tracks.title: 雞寮半暝 Ke-liâu Puànn-mê
tracks.mood: sweaty, rowdy and racing the clock
tracks.subject: a Yunlin chicken-catching crew (掠雞班) of seven racing to load 400 crates from a 6,000-bird broiler house before driver A-tsai's lorry has to leave at five for its slaughterhouse slot, while foreman A-gi stands on the lorry roof with his torch and calls every crate like a variety-show emcee, bringing on Auntie Tsu with four birds a hand without looking and the Su brothers stacking crates eight high as A-tsai checks his watch and honks; with fifty crates and ten minutes to go A-gi jumps down to catch too, and the 400th crate goes up on time while the rooster in the next village is only just crowing

tracks.title: 算鳥 Sǹg Tsiáu
tracks.mood: cold-fingered, patient and quietly delighted
tracks.subject: a volunteer on the January black-faced spoonbill census at a Tainan fish-pond roost at half past five, counting sleeping birds through a scope in the north wind while a retired teacher clicks the tally counter, losing the count at 240 when a kite circles and the whole flock lifts, and starting again to find twenty more than last year

tracks.title: 削球 Siah-kiû
tracks.mood: breathless, cocky and laughing at himself
tracks.subject: a young line worker at a Taichung bicycle factory who loses every lunch-hour table-tennis game beside the forklifts to Uncle Hok, a 61-year-old forklift driver who holds his bat like a pen and chops everything back without moving his feet, with the workers betting their Yakult, until at five to one he wins a single game 11-9 and Uncle Hok says tomorrow he'll try

tracks.title: 啦啦隊 La-la-tuī
tracks.mood: cheeky, sweaty and proud
tracks.subject: eleven boys of class 3-8 who lose the draw and must perform a girl-group routine in skirts and wigs at their high school's inter-class cheerleading competition, and the skinniest one at the top of the human pyramid becoming the whole school's idol

tracks.title: 放彼條 Pàng Hit Tiâu
tracks.mood: cheeky, warm and dancing despite herself
tracks.subject: a grandmother shouting for an old Taigi classic at the smart speaker her grandson bought, which keeps playing reggaeton instead, until she and the neighbour are dancing to it and ask for 'that one' again

tracks.title: 龍鬚 Lîng-tshiu
tracks.mood: tender, playful and sure of her
tracks.subject: a couple restoring a temple roof in Tainan in cut-porcelain (jian nian), she on the scaffold snipping red and green bowls into thin strips with her nippers and handing them down, he pressing each one into wet cement to build a dragon's whiskers, passing pieces back and forth all afternoon while the master shouts at them from below

tracks.title: 鹽水蜂炮 Kiâm-tsuí Phang-phàu
tracks.mood: fearless, smoke-filled and laughing in the noise
tracks.subject: a first-timer at the Yanshui beehive fireworks on Lantern Festival night, in a full-face helmet, a towel round his neck and three pairs of jeans, standing beside a seventy-year-old regular as the rocket towers are lit

tracks.title: 綠竹筍 Li̍k-tik-sún
tracks.mood: brisk, muddy-booted and racing the dawn
tracks.subject: two neighbouring green-bamboo-shoot farmers digging by headlamp at four in the morning, racing each other and the sunrise because a shoot that sees the sun turns bitter, with breakfast riding on the count

tracks.title: 跳有氧 Thiàu Iú-ióng
tracks.mood: sweaty, sheepish and laughing at itself
tracks.subject: a fifty-year-old man at his first riverside-park morning aerobics class, the only man among thirty aunties, always turning the wrong way

tracks.title: 補衫 Póo Sann
tracks.mood: shy, warm and slowly smitten
tracks.subject: a woman who keeps bringing clothes to a market alteration stall because she has fallen for the quiet man at the sewing machine, and the day he stops charging her

tracks.title: 洗車 Sé Tshia
tracks.mood: sunny, splashy and loose
tracks.subject: a Sunday-morning car wash in a narrow lane that turns into a hose and water-gun fight between an uncle, an auntie, a teenager and a dog

tracks.title: 喊價 Hiàm-kè
tracks.mood: tense, dramatic and finally triumphant
tracks.subject: a young restaurant cook at the dawn fish auction, bidding against a rival restaurant boss for the last big grouper on the floor

tracks.title: 早一拍 Tsá Tsi̍t Phik
tracks.mood: warm, amused and affectionate
tracks.subject: a Wednesday-night church choir rehearsal where the eighty-two-year-old tenor always comes in a beat early, and the conductor quietly starts following him

tracks.title: 浸跤 Tsìm Kha
tracks.mood: tender, patient and quietly amused
tracks.subject: a husband who has a basin of hot ginger water ready every night when his wife gets home from twelve hours standing at a department-store cosmetics counter

tracks.title: 剉冰 Tshuah-ping
tracks.mood: bright, clumsy and giggling
tracks.subject: three friends making mango shaved ice at home on a hot Sunday with a borrowed hand-crank ice shaver that jams every third turn

tracks.title: 曝鹽 Pha̍k Iâm
tracks.mood: weathered, steady and quietly proud
tracks.subject: the last salt worker still raking the Qigu salt pans every summer morning, teaching a crowd of tourists to push the wooden rake

tracks.title: 拔索 Pue̍h-soh
tracks.mood: rowdy, bouncing and laughing
tracks.subject: a tug-of-war at the neighbourhood sports day between the top and bottom ends of one lane, grandpas in front, aunties screaming orders and the rope snapping in the final

tracks.title: 雞公走去矣 Ke-kang Tsáu--khì--ah
tracks.mood: frantic, cheeky and out of breath
tracks.subject: a neighbour's rooster escaping at half past six on a Sunday and leading an old man in his vest, a shop clerk and the narrator through a convenience store

tracks.title: 主任衝啊 Tsú-jīm Tshiong--ah
tracks.mood: hoarse, proud and laughing at the dean
tracks.subject: students the dean of discipline has booked for long hair all term chanting him home on the anchor leg of the teachers' relay to win a hair amnesty

tracks.title: 麻糬 Muâ-tsî
tracks.mood: shy, warm and getting braver
tracks.subject: two strangers who each feed the same small stray dog on the riverside embankment at ten every night, each sure she is their dog and each calling her by a different name

tracks.title: 搬厝 Puann-tshù
tracks.mood: straight-faced loyalty with a grin
tracks.subject: four old classmates who swear over beer at midnight to help one of them move flat at six the next morning, and all four turn up

tracks.title: 象棋 Tshiūnn-kî
tracks.mood: mock-heroic and dead serious about a chess game
tracks.subject: two retired neighbours locked in an afternoon-long Chinese chess game under the temple banyan while the onlookers, who are meant to keep quiet, call every move

tracks.title: 早頓店 Tsá-tǹg-tiàm
tracks.mood: playful bickering, twenty years in love
tracks.subject: a husband and wife who have run a breakfast shop for twenty years, she calling every customer 'handsome' at the counter while he grumbles at the griddle, until she finally calls him it

tracks.title: 濾水器 Lī-tsuí-khì
tracks.mood: furious, then dancing about it
tracks.subject: dressing up for coffee with a high-school crush who calls after ten years of silence, and dancing out of the café when he opens a water-purifier catalogue

tracks.title: 摩天輪 Môo-thian-lûn
tracks.mood: giddy, shy and a little scheming
tracks.subject: a woman who plans to propose at the top of a seventeen-minute Ferris wheel ride and finds her boyfriend too scared of heights to open his eyes

tracks.title: 停電 Thîng-tiān
tracks.mood: quietly, happily in love in the dark
tracks.subject: a power cut on an October night and peeling a pomelo together by candlelight on the balcony

tracks.title: 奶矸 Ling-kan
tracks.mood: tender, sleepy and a little proud
tracks.subject: a new father's three a.m. bottle feed in a dark kitchen while the mother finally sleeps

tracks.title: 虱目魚 Sat-ba̍k-hî
tracks.mood: cheeky haggling that both sides enjoy
tracks.subject: a fishmonger and a sharp-tongued auntie haggling over a milkfish belly in rhymed seven-syllable banter at a morning market

tracks.title: 猴山仔 Kâu-san-á
tracks.mood: starving, furious and half laughing at itself
tracks.subject: a macaque on Kaohsiung's Chaishan snatching your pork-chop lunchbox before the first bite

tracks.title: 跋桮 Pua̍h-pue
tracks.mood: stubborn fury that ends in a grin
tracks.subject: nineteen laughing divination blocks on quitting a job, then one holy block once the question becomes a three-thousand raise

tracks.title: 挾尪仔 Ngeh Ang-á
tracks.mood: deadpan and smitten at one in the morning
tracks.subject: on a one a.m. claw-machine date she wins in one try the duck he fed six hundred dollars to, and hands it to him

tracks.title: 排桌 Pâi-toh
tracks.mood: frazzled, bossy and finally triumphant
tracks.subject: the bride's mother seating thirty banquet tables around two aunts who have not spoken in twenty years

tracks.title: 釣蝦場 Tiò-hê-tiûnn
tracks.mood: cocky, sleepy and laughing at one in the morning
tracks.subject: three friends at a 1 a.m. indoor shrimp-fishing hall betting a round of grilled shrimp on who lands the first catch, while the owner calls the time over the speaker

tracks.title: 火金蛄 Hué-kim-koo
tracks.mood: shy, warm, a first date in the dark
tracks.subject: a first date on an unlit mountain road in April, switching the torch off to wait for the fireflies

tracks.title: 半糖少冰 Puànn-thn̂g Tsió-ping
tracks.mood: bossy, fed up and laughing about it
tracks.subject: collecting the office bubble-tea order: twelve cups, twelve sugar levels and one 'whatever'

tracks.title: 糞埽車來矣 Pùn-sò-tshia Lâi--ah
tracks.mood: silly, bouncy and in a hurry
tracks.subject: children running the rubbish out when the garbage truck's music comes down the lane

tracks.title: 虼蚻 Ka-tsua̍h
tracks.mood: absurdly heroic about one cockroach
tracks.subject: the one family member sent into the kitchen at ten at night to face a flying cockroach with a can of insect spray

tracks.title: 放送頭 Hòng-sàng-thâu
tracks.mood: gossipy, deadpan and delighted
tracks.subject: a neighbourhood chief who forgets to switch off the loudspeaker while his wife finds his secret stash

tracks.title: 顧魚塭 Kòo Hî-ùn
tracks.mood: not fighting the sky, negotiating with it
tracks.subject: a father and child holding a collapsing fish-pond dyke through a typhoon night

tracks.title: 陣頭 Tīn-thâu
tracks.mood: seen by your mother for once
tracks.subject: a troupe of young labourers who become temple procession dancers once a year

tracks.title: 天井 Thian-tsínn
tracks.mood: calling your own name in an empty house
tracks.subject: rain falling into the courtyard of a grandmother's old house

tracks.title: 冷氣歹去 Líng-khì Pháinn--khì
tracks.mood: the two hot weeks you were closest
tracks.subject: the summer the air conditioner broke and two people slept on the floor for two weeks

tracks.title: 導覽阿伯 Tō-lám A-peh
tracks.mood: the question nobody asked for thirty years
tracks.subject: an old miner giving the same tour every day until a child asks if he was afraid

tracks.title: 稻草人 Tiū-chháu-lâng
tracks.mood: standing in for someone who is gone
tracks.subject: a scarecrow wearing a grandfather's shirt in a field about to be sold

tracks.title: 曝棉被 Pha̍k Mî-phuē
tracks.genre: Taigi jazz song with gekkin and oud
tracks.mood: warm, no suffering frame at all
tracks.subject: six quilts carried up to the roof to take the sun, and who turns them now

tracks.title: 豆油間 Tāu-iû-king
tracks.mood: time measured in jars
tracks.subject: a seventy-eight-year-old opening and closing a hundred and twenty soy sauce jars twice a day

tracks.title: 頭一聲阿嬤 Thâu-tsi̍t-siann A-má
tracks.mood: a debt paid in the wrong direction
tracks.subject: a fourteen-month-old whose first word is not mother or father

tracks.title: 點歌 Tiám-kua
tracks.mood: thirty years of listening and one night of being heard
tracks.subject: a father who listened to a midnight radio request show for thirty years and never called in

tracks.title: 離緣紙
tracks.mood: calm, no blame left
tracks.subject: eating one bowl of noodles together after filing the divorce papers

tracks.title: 載阿母去買拜拜的物件
tracks.mood: unsentimental warmth, no suffering frame
tracks.subject: driving your mother to the market to buy offerings on the first of the lunar month

tracks.title: 掛紙
tracks.mood: cold, murmured, waiting for an answer
tracks.subject: sweeping a grave, weighting the paper down and waiting for the wind to make it answer

tracks.title: 做一桌無人來食
tracks.mood: bright arrangement against a hollow room
tracks.subject: cooking for four and eating three mouthfuls alone

tracks.title: 騎車去還人的錢
tracks.genre: Taigi narrative rap over live band
tracks.mood: embarrassed gratitude
tracks.subject: riding over with five thousand in a red envelope to repay a friend who never once asked

tracks.title: 我的台語去佗位
tracks.mood: 歹勢閣毋甘
tracks.subject: 台語聽有毋過講袂出喙

tracks.title: 安全帽內底的汗
tracks.mood: 粗魯的疼惜
tracks.subject: 工地歇睏彼半點鐘

tracks.title: 西螺大橋落雨
tracks.mood: 硬喙但軟心
tracks.subject: 載阿公去廟裡彼條路

tracks.title: 月娘缺一角
tracks.mood: 冷靜的缺
tracks.subject: 厝內一个人的下晡

tracks.title: 捷運頂的台語
tracks.mood: 都市的自在
tracks.subject: 佇捷運聽著兩个少年講台語

tracks.title: 夜市收攤
tracks.mood: quiet and reflective
tracks.subject: closing the night market stall

tracks.title: 海口的風
tracks.mood: defiant and loud
tracks.subject: the wind at the harbour

tracks.title: 廟埕的戲棚
tracks.mood: warm and intimate
tracks.subject: an opera stage behind a temple

tracks.title: 落雨的月台
tracks.mood: wistful and nocturnal
tracks.subject: a platform in the rain

tracks.title: 鐵工廠的歌
tracks.mood: defiant and loud
tracks.subject: an iron works closing down

tracks.title: 檳榔攤的燈
tracks.mood: quiet and reflective
tracks.subject: the light of a betel nut stall

tracks.title: 阮無欲轉去
tracks.mood: restless and urgent
tracks.subject: not going home yet

tracks.title: 海湧的聲
tracks.mood: hazy and sunlit
tracks.subject: the sound of waves at twenty

tracks.title: 阿嬤的縫紉車
tracks.mood: quiet and reflective
tracks.subject: a grandmother's sewing machine

tracks.title: 透早的菜市仔
tracks.mood: bright and hopeful
tracks.subject: the market before dawn
